scope: descriptive join-grain audit of the existing authorized input snapshot; no new model fit
eligibility: application_train excluding CODE_GENDER=XNA, matching the selected-feature recipe

hypothetical_direct_left_join.definition: Left join application_train to bureau and previous_application on SK_ID_CURR without aggregation. Per-applicant multiplicity = max(bureau_count,1)*max(previous_application_count,1).

interpretation: This computes the row multiplicity of a counterfactual naive join; the maintained pipeline aggregates first and does not perform this erroneous join. It is not an observed production incident or a fitted-model causal experiment.
